name: hipblaslt-kernel-hover
description: Hover a Tensile kernel name and view only that kernel's YAML parameters.

commands.title: Apply edited kernel buffer back to source YAML

hipblasltKernelHover.enabled.description: Enable hover to show a single Tensile kernel block.

hipblasltKernelHover.applyOnSave.description: When editing a kernel buffer, pressing Ctrl+S applies changes back to the source YAML automatically.

hipblasltKernelHover.closeEditorOnSave.description: After Ctrl+S applies edits back to source, close the temporary kernel editor and return to the source YAML.

hipblasltKernelHover.maxHoverChars.description: If the kernel YAML exceeds this size, the hover shows a link to open it in an editor instead.

hipblasltKernelHover.triggerKeys.description: Only trigger hover when hovering over the value of these YAML keys.
